function.description: Gets a list of all SDA fabric sites along with their readiness status for Security Service Insertion (SSI) deployment.
function.name: api_sdaFabricSitesReadiness

order.description: Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response.

sortBy.description: Sort results by the fabric site name.

response.description: Response object containing a list of SDA fabric sites.

borderDeviceCount.description: The count of border devices in the fabric site.

edgeDeviceCount.description: The count of edge devices in the fabric site.

fabricSiteName.description: The name of the fabric site.

id.description: The unique identifier of the SDA fabric site.

lispPubsub.description: Indicates whether Lisp Pub/Sub is enabled or disabled.

mapServerDeviceCount.description: The count of map server devices in the fabric site.

message.description: Additional message regarding the fabric site readiness

readiness.description: The readiness status of the fabric site.

virtualNetworkCount.description: The total number of virtual networks present in the fabric site.
